author: nickyeow

author: nickyeow

english.text: In Cantonese, we don't say "I love you" so directly, but "I like you".

jyutping: hai2 jyut6 jyu5 jap6 min6 jat1 bun1 m4 wui5 gong2「ngo5 oi3 nei5」gam3 zik6 zip3，ji4 hai6 wui5 gong2「ngo5 zung1 ji3 nei5」
text: 喺粵語入面一般唔會講「我愛妳」咁直接，而係會講「我鍾意妳」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A cerulean sky and breezy warm weather was today, the 20th of July of 2025, here on Lulu Island. As usual, I walk to Tim Hortons café for summer drinks. At home, there is a Filipino dessert of sticky rice balls, jackfruit pieces, and tapioca pearls in coconut milk. Lunch was a curry rice dish much like Beef Rendang, but it wasn't. I walked my 72nd time this "Krismas" year to the "Clam Temple," the Roman Catholic church at St. Albans Road. On the way, in the immaculate garden of the Korean lady, was a hummingbird floating in the air. I delighted myself by whispering in Esperanto, "Kolibro!" (Hummingbird!). At the church lobby were two Kenyan ladies in beautiful colourful African gowns. I complimented: "Your clothing is really nice!" As I was sitting at the back of the near-empty nave, a Filipina worshipper approached and irksomely asked that I take off my green safari hat as a sign of respect. "Sorry!" I exclaimed. Later, at the front of the nave was an ongoing baptism of a Filipino baby boy named Mateo. Filipinos gathered around, there with the white minister and a Filipina nun. As I walked home, I said in Esperanto, "La loko estas magia!" (The place is magical!).

jyutping: gam1 jat6，2025 nin4 7 jyut6 20 hou6，hai2 lou6 lou6 dou2，tin1 hung1 wai3 laam4，tin1 hei3 mei4 fung1 wan1 nyun5。 ngo5 tung4 ping4 si4 jat1 joeng6，haang4 heoi3 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 haa6 jat6 jam2 ban2。 hai2 uk1 kei2，jau5 go3 fei1 leot6 ban1 tim4 ban2，hai6 no6 mai5 tyun4、ngau4 jau4 gwo2 pin3 tung4 maai4 je4 naai5 jap6 min6 ge3 muk6 syu4 zan1 zyu1。 ng5 caan1 hai6 jat1 dou6 gaa3 lei1 faan6 coi3，hou2 ci5 ngau4 juk6 jan4 dong1 gam2，daan6 hai6 m4 hai6。 ngo5 gam1 nin4「sing3 daan3」dai6 72 ci3 haang4 heoi3「gap3 lei4 miu2」，zik1 hai6 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2。 tou4 zung1，hai2 hon4 gwok3 neoi5 si6 ge3 jyun4 mei5 faa1 jyun2 jap6 min6，jau5 zek3 fung1 niu5 fau4 hai2 hung1 zung1。 ngo5 jung6 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 sai3 sai3 seng1 gam2 gong2「 Kolibro ! 」，ling6 zi6 gei2 hou2 hoi1 sam1。（fung1 niu5！）。 hai2 gaau3 tong2 daai6 tong4 jau5 loeng5 wai6 hang2 aa3 neoi5 si6 zoek3 zyu6 leng3 di1 ge3 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 fei1 zau1 pou4。 ngo5 zaan3：「nei5 di1 saam1 zan1 hai6 hou2 zeng3！」 dong1 ngo5 zo6 hai2 gei1 fu4 hung1 mou4 jat1 jan4 ge3 zing3 din6 hau6 min6 go2 zan6，jau5 go3 fei1 leot6 ban1 sung4 baai3 ze2 zau2 gan6，hou2 faan4 gam2 jiu1 kau4 ngo5 ceoi4 dai1 ngo5 ge3 luk6 sik1 je5 sang1 dung6 mat6 jyun4 mou2，ji5 si6 zyun1 zung6。「deoi3 m4 zyu6！」 ngo5 haam3 zo2 ceot1 lai4。 hau6 loi4，hai2 zing3 din6 cin4 min6 jau5 go3 fei1 leot6 ban1 naam4 jing1，ming4 giu3 maa5 dak6 ou3，ci4 zuk6 sai2 lai5。 fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4 zeoi6 zaap6 maai4 saai3 hai2 sei3 zau1，go2 dou6 tung4 baak6 jan4 bou6 zoeng2 tung4 jat1 go3 fei1 leot6 ban1 sau1 neoi2 jat1 cai4。 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2 go2 zan6，ngo5 jung6 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 gong2：「 La loko estas magia！」（go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 san4 kei4！）。
text: 今日，2025年7月20號，喺露露島，天空蔚藍，天氣微風溫暖。 我同平時一樣，行去 Tim Hortons 咖啡廳飲夏日飲品。 喺屋企，有個菲律賓甜品，係糯米糰、牛油果片同埋椰奶入面嘅木薯珍珠。 午餐係一道咖喱飯菜，好似牛肉仁當噉，但係唔係。 我今年「聖誕」第72次行去「蛤蜊廟」，即係聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂。 途中，喺韓國女士嘅完美花園入面，有隻蜂鳥浮喺空中。 我用世界語細細聲噉講「 Kolibro ! 」，令自己好開心。（蜂鳥！）。 喺教堂大堂有兩位肯亞女士着住靚啲嘅五顏六色非洲袍。 我讚：「你啲衫真係好正！」 當我坐喺幾乎空無一人嘅正殿後面嗰陣，有個菲律賓崇拜者走近，好煩噉要求我除低我嘅綠色野生動物園帽，以示尊重。「對唔住！」 我喊咗出嚟。 後來，喺正殿前面有個菲律賓男嬰，名叫馬特奧，持續洗禮。 菲律賓人聚集埋晒喺四周，嗰度同白人部長同一個菲律賓修女一齊。 行返屋企嗰陣，我用世界語講：「 La loko estas magia！」（個地方好神奇！）。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The author of Esperanto lacked a clear concept of the endless struggle existing, more or less acutely at times, between social classes. He didn't see that the causes of war lay in the principles themselves on which human relations were based. However, his goal was essentially similar to ours. He wished to unite humanity into "one great family group."

jyutping: 《sai3 gaai3 jyu5》ge3 zok3 ze2 deoi3 se5 wui2 gaai1 kap1 zi1 gaan1 cyun4 zoi6 ge3 mou4 kung4 mou4 zeon6 ge3 dau3 zang1 kyut3 fat6 cing1 sik1 ge3 koi3 nim6，jau5 si4 waak6 do1 waak6 siu2 hai6 gap1 sing3 ge3。keoi5 mou5 tai2 dou2 zin3 zang1 ge3 jyun4 jan1 hai6 hai2 jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6 so2 gin3 laap6 ge3 jyun4 zak1 bun2 san1。bat1 gwo3，keoi5 ge3 muk6 biu1 tung4 ngo5 dei6 ge3 muk6 biu1 bun2 zat1 soeng6 hai6 soeng1 ci5 ge3。keoi5 hei1 mong6 zoeng1 jan4 leoi6 tyun4 git3 sing4「jat1 go3 wai5 daai6 ge3 gaa1 ting4 kwan4 tai2」。
text: 《世界語》嘅作者對社會階級之間存在嘅無窮無盡嘅鬥爭缺乏清晰嘅概念，有時或多或少係急性嘅。佢冇睇到戰爭嘅原因係喺人際關係所建立嘅原則本身。不過，佢嘅目標同我哋嘅目標本質上係相似嘅。佢希望將人類團結成「一個偉大嘅家庭群體」。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: “The music of the Yazidi people is absolutely essential to their culture,” Bochmann told VOA. “Only one section of the people, the Qawals caste, are allowed to sing the music. There are only 16 of them left, and so we thought it would be essential in case another genocide took place, or anything else horrific, that we lodge this and record it.”

jyutping: bok3 haak1 maan6 deoi3 mei5 gwok3 zi1 jam1 biu2 si6：「ngaa5 cai4 dik6 jan4 ge3 jam1 ngok6 deoi3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 man4 faa3 zyut6 deoi3 hai6 bit1 jiu3 ge3。」「zi2 jau5 jat1 bou6 fan6 jan4，zik1 hai6 kaa1 ngaa5 ji5 zung2 sing3，ho2 ji5 coeng3 ne1 sau2 go1。keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 zing6 dai1 faan2 16 go3 jan4，so2 ji5 ngo5 dei6 gok3 dak1 maan6 jat1 faat3 sang1 ling6 jat1 coeng4 zung2 zuk6 mit6 zyut6，waak6 ze2 jau5 kei4 taa1 ho2 paa3 ge3 si6，ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 gaau1 ni1 go3 bing6 luk6 zai3 maai4 ne1 sau2 go1 hai6 bit1 jiu3 ge3。」
text: 博赫曼對美國之音表示：「雅齊迪人嘅音樂對佢哋嘅文化絕對係必要嘅。」「只有一部分人，即係卡瓦爾種姓，可以唱呢首歌。佢哋只係剩低返16個人，所以我哋覺得萬一發生另一場種族滅絕，或者有其他可怕嘅事，我哋要提交呢個並錄製埋呢首歌係必要嘅。」
